title: Lentil Vegetable Soup
description: A hearty vegan lentil soup with mixed vegetables. Rich in plant protein, fiber, and iron for fat loss.
instructions: Saute onion, garlic, and carrot in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add red lentils and diced tomatoes and stir.
Pour in vegetable stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with cumin, turmeric, and salt and serve hot.

title: Caprese Salad with Quinoa
description: A Mediterranean vegetarian lunch with fresh mozzarella, tomatoes, and quinoa. Light and refreshing with good protein.
instructions: Cook quinoa and let it cool.
Slice mozzarella and tomatoes.
Combine quinoa, mozzarella, and tomatoes in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and garnish with fresh basil.

title: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Classic grilled chicken Caesar salad with romaine and low-fat dressing. High protein and low calorie.
instructions: Season chicken breast and grill for 6-7 minutes per side.
Slice chicken and let rest.
Toss romaine with cottage cheese dressing and lemon.
Top with sliced chicken and serve.

title: Tuna Nicoise Salad
description: A classic French Nicoise salad with tuna and vegetables. Packed with protein and essential nutrients.
instructions: Boil eggs for 8 minutes and cool.
Drain tuna and arrange on a plate with cucumber and tomato.
Halve the boiled eggs and add to the plate.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon dressing.

title: Beef Lettuce Wrap
description: Low-carb Asian-style ground beef lettuce wraps. A lean, protein-rich meal with vibrant flavor.
instructions: Cook ground beef in a pan with garlic and ginger until browned.
Season with soy sauce, sesame oil, and chili flakes.
Spoon mixture into large lettuce leaves.
Top with diced carrot and serve immediately.

title: Chickpea Salad Wrap
description: A hearty vegan wrap with spiced chickpeas and fresh vegetables. High in fiber and plant protein.
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas and mash lightly.
Mix with diced cucumber, tomato, onion, and lemon juice.
Season with cumin, coriander, and salt.
Spread onto a whole wheat wrap and roll up.

title: Paneer Tikka Salad
description: A flavorful Indian vegetarian salad with grilled paneer tikka. High in protein and perfect for midday meals.
instructions: Marinate paneer cubes in yogurt, turmeric, and garam masala for 10 minutes.
Grill or pan-cook paneer until lightly charred.
Arrange over a bed of spinach and cucumber.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve.

title: Cod Zucchini Bake
description: A light and protein-rich baked cod with zucchini. Low calorie and ideal for fat loss goals.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C.
Place cod fillet on a baking tray with sliced zucchini.
Drizzle with olive oil, garlic, and lemon juice.
Bake for 18-20 minutes and serve hot.

title: Lamb Keema Roti Bowl
description: A hearty Indian-style minced lamb keema served with roti. Rich in protein and iron for strength training.
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil until golden.
Add ground lamb with spices and cook until browned.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with warm roti.

title: Tofu Brown Rice Stir Fry
description: A simple vegan stir fry with tofu and brown rice. Provides complete plant protein and sustained energy.
instructions: Press and cube tofu, then pan-fry until golden.
Add broccoli, bell pepper, and garlic to the pan.
Stir fry for 5 minutes and add cooked brown rice.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil, then serve.

title: Dal Makhani Brown Rice
description: A rich Indian vegetarian black lentil dal served with brown rice. High in protein and complex carbs.
instructions: Pressure cook lentils until soft.
Saute onion, garlic, and tomato in butter.
Add cooked lentils with spices and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve over brown rice.

title: Turkey Meatball Zucchini Noodles
description: Lean turkey meatballs with zucchini noodles and tomato sauce. Low carb, high protein for body recomposition.
instructions: Mix ground turkey with garlic, salt, and pepper and form small balls.
Pan-cook meatballs until browned and cooked through.
Spiralize zucchini and saute briefly.
Serve meatballs over zucchini noodles with tomato sauce.

title: Prawn Coconut Curry
description: A fragrant prawn curry with coconut milk. Rich in protein and healthy fats from coconut.
instructions: Saute onion, garlic, and ginger in coconut oil.
Add curry paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add shrimp and coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve over brown rice.

title: Soy Chunk Palak Rice
description: An Indian-style vegan soy chunk and spinach rice bowl. Excellent plant protein with iron-rich greens.
instructions: Soak soy chunks in hot water for 10 minutes, then squeeze dry.
Saute onion and spices, add soy chunks and spinach.
Add cooked rice and stir fry together.
Season with salt and cumin and serve hot.

title: Chicken Breast Sweet Potato Curry
description: A nourishing chicken and sweet potato curry with warming spices. Packed with protein, beta-carotene, and complex carbs.
instructions: Cube chicken breast and brown in olive oil.
Add diced sweet potato and onion and stir.
Add curry paste, tomatoes, and water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve as a standalone bowl or with rice.

title: Salmon Miso Broccoli Bowl
description: A Japanese-inspired salmon and broccoli bowl with miso. High in omega-3s and cruciferous vegetables.
instructions: Marinate salmon in miso paste and sesame oil for 10 minutes.
Bake salmon at 200C for 15 minutes.
Steam broccoli until tender-crisp.
Serve salmon over brown rice with broccoli.

title: Black Bean Sweet Potato Tacos
description: Flavorful vegan tacos with black beans and roasted sweet potato. High in fiber and plant protein.
instructions: Roast diced sweet potato with cumin and chili powder at 200C.
Warm black beans with smoked paprika and salt.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with sweet potato, black beans, and avocado.

title: Egg Paneer Curry
description: A rich Indian curry combining boiled eggs and paneer in a spiced tomato gravy. Dual-protein vegetarian feast.
instructions: Boil eggs and halve them.
Saute onion, garlic, and tomato in oil with spices.
Add paneer cubes and boiled eggs.
Simmer for 10 minutes and serve with rice or roti.

title: Beef Stir Fry with Vegetables
description: A quick Asian-style beef stir fry with colorful vegetables. High in protein and iron for strength athletes.
instructions: Slice beef thinly and marinate in soy sauce and ginger.
Stir fry beef in a hot wok for 3-4 minutes.
Add broccoli, bell pepper, and mushrooms and stir fry 4 more minutes.
Serve over brown rice or noodles.

title: Kidney Bean Quinoa Power Bowl
description: A vegan power bowl with kidney beans, quinoa, and avocado. Complete protein and healthy fats for endurance.
instructions: Cook quinoa and set aside.
Warm kidney beans with cumin, smoked paprika, and salt.
Assemble bowl with quinoa, kidney beans, and sliced avocado.
Drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil.

title: Mozzarella Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Roasted bell peppers stuffed with quinoa and mozzarella. A satisfying vegetarian lunch with balanced macros.
instructions: Halve bell peppers and remove seeds.
Mix cooked quinoa with diced tomatoes and herbs.
Fill peppers with quinoa mixture and top with mozzarella.
Bake at 200C for 20 minutes until cheese is golden.

title: Grilled Shrimp Quinoa Bowl
description: A lean protein bowl with grilled shrimp and quinoa. Low calorie, high protein, and packed with nutrients.
instructions: Season shrimp with garlic, paprika, and lemon.
Grill shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side.
Cook quinoa and let cool.
Serve shrimp over quinoa with cucumber and tomato.

title: Tempeh Millet Power Bowl
description: A vegan power bowl with tempeh, millet, and roasted vegetables. Dense in plant protein and complex carbs.
instructions: Cook millet according to package instructions.
Pan-fry tempeh slices until golden on both sides.
Roast broccoli and bell pepper with olive oil at 200C.
Assemble bowl with millet, tempeh, and roasted vegetables.

title: Spinach Ricotta Stuffed Chicken
description: Juicy chicken breast stuffed with spinach and ricotta. An impressive high-protein Italian-style dinner.
instructions: Butterfly chicken breast and season inside.
Mix cottage cheese with wilted spinach and stuff chicken.
Seal with toothpicks and sear in an oven-proof pan.
Bake at 190C for 20 minutes and rest before serving.

title: Beef Barley Vegetable Stew
description: A slow-cooked beef and barley stew with root vegetables. A hearty, calorie-dense meal for serious athletes.
instructions: Brown ground beef in a pot with onion and garlic.
Add barley, carrots, and beef stock.
Simmer covered for 35 minutes until barley is tender.
Season with salt, thyme, and black pepper.

title: Chickpea Coconut Spinach Curry
description: A creamy vegan chickpea curry with coconut milk and spinach. Iron-rich and satisfying for dinner.
instructions: Saute onion, garlic, and ginger in coconut oil.
Add curry powder and canned chickpeas, stir well.
Pour in coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add spinach, cook until wilted, and serve with rice.

title: Baked Cod with Quinoa Pilaf
description: A light Mediterranean baked cod served with herb quinoa. Clean protein and complex carbs for lean muscle.
instructions: Cook quinoa with herbs and season.
Season cod fillet with lemon zest, garlic, and olive oil.
Bake cod at 200C for 18 minutes.
Serve cod over quinoa with a lemon wedge.

title: Soy Chunk Mushroom Masala
description: A protein-packed vegan soy chunk and mushroom masala. Excellent plant-based dinner for muscle support.
instructions: Soak soy chunks in hot water, drain and press.
Saute onion, ginger, and garlic in oil.
Add mushrooms, soy chunks, and masala spices.
Add tomatoes, simmer 12 minutes, and serve with roti.
